statements.label: supported
statements.text: Knockdown of the Lactobacillus rhamnosus monooxygenase ycnE by the ginger nanoparticle microRNA mdo-miR7267-3p raised indole-3-carboxaldehyde levels.
statements.evidence: GELN mdo-miR7267-3p-mediated targeting of the LGG monooxygenase ycnE yields increased indole-3-carboxaldehyde (I3A)
statements.note: The abstract states that this microRNA-mediated targeting of ycnE yields increased I3A.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Dietary ginger reduced colitis severity in patients with inflammatory bowel disease.
statements.evidence: These findings reveal how plant products and their effects on the microbiome may be used to target specific host processes to alleviate disease.
statements.note: The colitis experiments reported are in mice, and the closing sentence only proposes that plant products may be used this way, so nothing here speaks to patients.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Lactobacillaceae took up ginger exosome-like nanoparticles preferentially, and this uptake depended on the nanoparticles' lipids.
statements.evidence: Ginger ELNs (GELNs) are preferentially taken up by Lactobacillaceae in a GELN lipid-dependent manner
statements.note: The abstract reports preferential, lipid-dependent uptake of GELNs by Lactobacillaceae.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: RNAs from ginger exosome-like nanoparticles eased colitis in mice through mechanisms that required IL-22.
statements.evidence: These functions of GELN-RNAs can ameliorate mouse colitis via IL-22-dependent mechanisms.
statements.note: The abstract reports amelioration of mouse colitis by GELN-RNAs via IL-22-dependent mechanisms.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Mice transgenic for apoptosis repressor with CARD domain mounted reduced hypertrophic responses.
statements.evidence: Apoptosis repressor with CARD domain transgenic mice showed reduced hypertrophic responses.
statements.note: The abstract reports reduced hypertrophic responses in ARC transgenic mice.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Mice overexpressing miR-223 went on to develop cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure, while mice lacking miR-223 withstood hypertrophic stimuli.
statements.evidence: miR-223 transgenic mice developed cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure, whereas miR-223-deficient mice were protected from hypertrophic stimuli
statements.note: Both mouse phenotypes are reported, and the abstract reads them as miR-223 acting as a positive regulator of hypertrophy.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Treating mice with an antisense inhibitor of miR-223 improved survival after hypertrophic stimulation.
statements.evidence: Modulation of their levels provides an attractive therapeutic target for the treatment of cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure.
statements.note: The abstract proposes the pathway as a therapeutic target but reports no inhibitor treatment and no survival measurement.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The circular RNA HRCR bound miR-223 directly in the cytoplasm, and forcing HRCR expression in cardiomyocytes and in mice attenuated hypertrophic responses.
statements.evidence: Heart-related circRNA directly bound to miR-223 in cytoplasm and enforced expression of HRCR in cardiomyocytes and in mice both exhibited attenuated hypertrophic responses.
statements.note: The abstract reports direct cytoplasmic binding and attenuated hypertrophic responses upon enforced HRCR expression in both settings.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Polysome profiling placed PABPN1 translation under positive control by HuR and negative control by CircPABPN1.
statements.evidence: Evaluation of PABPN1 mRNA polysomes indicated that PABPN1 translation was modulated positively by HuR and hence negatively by CircPABPN1.
statements.note: The polysome analysis is reported as showing exactly these opposite directions of regulation.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Among the HuR-bound circular RNAs in HeLa cells, hsa_circ_0031288 stood out; it comes from the PABPN1 pre-mRNA and was named CircPABPN1.
statements.evidence: One of the most prominent HuR target circRNAs was hsa_circ_0031288, renamed CircPABPN1 as it arises from the PABPN1 pre-mRNA.
statements.note: The abstract identifies this circRNA as one of the most prominent HuR targets and gives its origin and new name.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: CircPABPN1 is more abundant in cervical carcinoma tissue than in healthy cervical tissue.
statements.evidence: Here, we have identified en masse circRNAs binding HuR in human cervical carcinoma HeLa cells.
statements.note: The work is done in HeLa cells and the abstract never compares CircPABPN1 levels between tumour and normal tissue.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: HuR left the amount of CircPABPN1 unchanged, yet abundant CircPABPN1 lowered HuR binding to PABPN1 mRNA.
statements.evidence: HuR did not influence CircPABPN1 abundance; interestingly, however, high levels of CircPABPN1 suppressed HuR binding to PABPN1 mRNA.
statements.note: Both halves are reported: no effect of HuR on circRNA abundance, and suppression of HuR binding by high CircPABPN1.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Blocking NAT10 slows the proliferation of cancer cells that rely on acetylated mRNAs.
statements.evidence: These findings expand the repertoire of mRNA modifications to include an acetylated residue and establish a role for ac4C in the regulation of mRNA translation.
statements.note: The reported consequences of ac4C concern mRNA stability, translation and decoding, with no measurement of cell proliferation or cancer.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Mapping ac4C across the transcriptome showed acetylation confined to discrete regions that were enriched in coding sequences.
statements.evidence: Transcriptome-wide mapping of ac4C revealed discretely acetylated regions that were enriched within coding sequences.
statements.note: The abstract reports discrete acetylated regions enriched within coding sequences.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Loss of NAT10 cut ac4C signal at the mapped mRNA sites and came with global downregulation of the target mRNAs.
statements.evidence: Ablation of NAT10 reduced ac4C detection at the mapped mRNA sites and was globally associated with target mRNA downregulation.
statements.note: Both effects of NAT10 ablation are reported: less ac4C at mapped sites and globally downregulated target mRNAs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Within ac4C peaks, cytidine was over-represented at wobble positions, a bias shown experimentally to affect how efficiently mRNA is decoded.
statements.evidence: Codon content analysis within ac4C peaks uncovered a biased representation of cytidine within wobble sites that was empirically determined to influence mRNA decoding efficiency.
statements.note: The codon content analysis is reported as finding this wobble-site cytidine bias and tying it empirically to decoding efficiency.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Poly(I:C) stimulation or viral infection led RNase L to degrade circRNAs globally, a step needed for PKR activation early in innate immune responses.
statements.evidence: Upon poly(I:C) stimulation or viral infection, circRNAs are globally degraded by RNase L, a process required for PKR activation in early cellular innate immune responses.
statements.note: The abstract reports global RNase L-mediated circRNA degradation under these stimuli and calls it required for early PKR activation.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Endogenous circRNAs typically fold into imperfect duplexes of 16 to 26 base pairs and inhibit the double-stranded-RNA-activated kinase PKR.
statements.evidence: endogenous circRNAs tend to form 16-26 bp imperfect RNA duplexes and act as inhibitors of double-stranded RNA (dsRNA)-activated protein kinase (PKR) related to innate immunity
statements.note: The abstract gives both the 16-26 bp imperfect duplex structure and the inhibitory action on PKR.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Raising circRNA levels lowered disease activity scores in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus.
statements.evidence: overexpression of the dsRNA-containing circRNA in PBMCs or T cells derived from SLE can alleviate the aberrant PKR activation cascade, thus providing a connection between circRNAs and SLE
statements.note: The overexpression result concerns PKR signalling in patient-derived cells, and the abstract reports no clinical measure of disease activity.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Blood mononuclear cells from systemic lupus erythematosus patients carried higher PKR phosphorylation alongside lower circRNA levels.
statements.evidence: Augmented PKR phosphorylation and circRNA reduction are found in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) derived from patients with autoimmune disease systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).
statements.note: The abstract reports augmented PKR phosphorylation together with reduced circRNA in PBMCs from SLE patients.
